buyers_guide.q: What does a smart relay do?
buyers_guide.a: It hides behind a wall switch, inside a fan canopy, or in an appliance and switches the power, so you keep your existing switch and add smart control. Dry-contact relays can also trigger garage doors, gas fireplaces, and boilers.

buyers_guide.q: Do I need a neutral wire?
buyers_guide.a: Most relays do. Check your switch box for a bundle of white wires before buying. A few models work without a neutral, and the table notes which.

buyers_guide.q: Is it safe to install myself?
buyers_guide.a: Only if you're comfortable with household wiring and turn the breaker off first. If you're not sure, have an electrician install it. Never exceed the relay's amp rating.
